text:
Ravi: Heads-up — support ticket #5471: customer acct `acme-prod` reports p99 latency jump on chat.generate after the 22:15 rollout. p95 ~ 350ms, p99 ~ 2.4s, user-visible timeouts for streaming. seeing this across multiple regions. :frowning:

Jessica: Ugh. Any obvious errors in logs? stack traces? which kernel selection did the rollout flip?

Ravi: No stack traces, just slow end-to-end token generation. The rollout changed the kernel selection heuristic to "kerneltuner-v2" (auto-select) + a new compile flag `ATTN_PIPELINE=optimized`.

Mark: Can you paste the p99 time series and a sample span from tracing? also was KV-cache warm? sometimes cold-cache + new kernel = bad.

Ravi: pasted series (snippet):
```
2026-03-15T22:14 p99=0.39s
2026-03-15T22:16 p99=2.12s
2026-03-15T22:20 p99=2.40s
```
Trace sample: long stall in attention kernel dispatch, wait on `kerneltuner select_kernel()` for ~1.8s before tokens start.

Sophia: That wait is the selector trying to compile a specialized kernel variant at runtime — we've seen this when `hot_compile=true` and `kerneltuner` chooses to generate a size-optimized kernel. Did the rollout enable hot compilation?

Ravi: Yes, the new profile flips `hot_compile` on for batch sizes >= 1.

Jessica: Ok. Short mitigation: force pool to fallback selection (stable kernels) while we investigate. Command:
```
# immediate mitigation
redwoodctl pools update prod --kernel-policy=fallback
# OR toggle per-model
redwoodctl models set attn_kernel_policy --model=redwood-chat-v1 --policy=fallback
```

Mark: @infra-bot can you apply the pool policy change and confirm no restart required? we want minimal customer impact.

infra-bot: Applying `kernel_policy=fallback` to pool `prod`... Done. No restart required. Routing updated in 12s. :white_check_mark:

support-bot: Notified customer #5471 that we applied a temporary kernel fallback and will follow up. They report latency improvement in the first 30s: p99 dropped to ~430ms, streaming resumed. :thumbsup:

Sophia: Nice. Can someone repro locally with the same model + compile flag? I want to see if the compile step is non-deterministic and blocks.

Mark: I'll repro on a dev GPU: steps
1) checkout release tag `2026-03-15-rollout`
2) set ENV `ATTN_PIPELINE=optimized`, `KERNELTUNER_MODE=auto`, `HOT_COMPILE=true`
3) run `python bench/generate.py --model redwood-chat-v1 --seq 1024 --batch 1 --warmup 5 --iters 20`

Mark: Repro logs show `compile: generating kernel variant` and a 1.6-1.9s stall on first request, subsequent requests fast. So it's the hot compile jitter.

Sophia: That explains customer impact for low-throughput / bursty chat where cold kernels get compiled on demand. We need two follow-ups:
- short: disable hot_compile by default (rollback flag) and keep `kernel_policy=fallback` for prod pools
- medium: implement async ahead-of-time compilation during deploy / warmup phase to avoid blocking requests

Jessica: Agreed. I'll open a patch to revert the `ATTN_PIPELINE=optimized` compile flag and set `HOT_COMPILE=false` for the next patch release. Also adding a pre-deploy warmup job for dedicated pools.

Ravi: TL;DR: mitigation applied, customer confirmed improvement. Next: patch to revert compile flag + add ATO compile job. Please include an announcement on the rollout page and add to postmortem if needed.

Sophia: I'll create an engineering task (ENG-1229) for async/AOT compile and another (ENG-1230) for kernel selector telemetry (to detect compile stalls >200ms).

Mark: One more: add a temporary health-check that pings first request path and triggers AOT compile if response >500ms for a pool. Helps automated heals.

infra-bot: Created incident follow-up cards: ENG-1229, ENG-1230. Notified #postmortems. :spiral_note_pad:

Ravi: thanks all. I'll leave the thread open until the revert PR is merged and the customer confirms final stability.

Jessica: PR opened: `revert/attn-hot-compile` — assigning to @Sophia for review. ETA 2h.

Sophia: Reviewing now. Quick note: add a feature flag to re-enable hot_compile only after AOT is in place.

Ravi: Great. Updating support ticket with timeline and next steps. Closing loop after PR -> deploy -> customer confirmation. :eyes:
